title: Levels 6 (Lights Out) and 6.1 (the Snackrooms)
note: Both levels in one map: Level 6's shots carry a '6-' prefix (all are inspection shots, daylight and a lantern; Level 6 is black by design). review/baseline/6 and /6.1 were reshot in B9 on a build of unchanged main (the B0 sets are kept as 6-b0 and 6.1-b0). B9 replaced 6.1's black gate, threshold and sleepingbag spots (targets in dark Level 6) with close spots for a shelf, a checkout, a snack-bar counter, a table, the snack machine, a fridge and a kitchen, and added Level 6 inspection spots for the dead switch, chalk, a tripwire and standing water.
